findings.issue: The suffix is 3ms (his hands) as what they support. After the plural subject Aarón y Jur, «en sus manos» can be read as support located in their hands.
וַיְהִי is 3ms; «fueron» is plural to agree with «manos». The dual subject and the noun predicate are unchanged.

notes: Singular piedra, noun firmeza, and the repeated desde este uno stay inside the tokens.
